product_from_film: Figma Sites turns designs into responsive websites with interactions, generated components and publishing.
explains_well: The same layouts are shown at several widths, and an analog clock moves from prompt to code preview to the page.
unclear: Publishing is presented as a final button without a visible live URL, while the many interaction controls pass too quickly for their setup to be clear.
scenario: Adapt layouts, add interactions and a clock component, collaborate and publish.
product_clear_basis: The same page appears at desktop and narrower widths through a breakpoint selector.

lessons.keep: Show a custom component in the final page after generating it.
lessons.avoid: Stopping a publishing story at the button without showing the published result.
lessons.open: Live publishing, browser behavior, component correctness, exact animation timing and audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, carry a requested interactive campaign element from prompt to preview to the published landing page.
Add a live-page confirmation after Publish site and compare whether the workflow feels complete.

comparison.story: Introduce web design breadth. → Show adaptation across screen sizes. → Show collaborative page assembly. → Connect interaction settings to a designed site. → Show custom component creation and placement. → Show collaborative behavior design carried into a page. → Close with the publishing promise.
comparison.motion: Pages resize and reflow, blocks change across variants, image strips move through interaction examples, a clock appears from a prompt, arrows rotate around the cursor, and site previews stack before publishing. Sampling scope: 1 fps unless a closer window is recorded.
